tools.name: SmartEnterpriseMCPAgents_mcphawk_get_project_details
tools.description: Returns comprehensive metadata about an MCPHawk Inc projects This tool provides detailed information about a specific project, including: - Project start and end dates - Project classification - 'Tier 1 (High budget, long duration, senior involvement)' - 'Tier 2 (Medium budget and duration)', - 'Tier 3 (Low effort, short-term, often POC or pilot-level) - Impact of the project at customer side to understand what it means to customer and evaluate the risk during execution. - Enablement - Optimization - Innovation - Project complexity to understand and mitigate any project risk during execution and values are - Very High - High - Medium - Simple - Technology detail like - cloud environment (AWS, GCP, Azure) - cloud native tool (dbt, Fivetran, HVR etc) - Data Warehouse Tools (snowflake, databricks, Spark etc) - Project Domain line Marketing, Healthcare, Finance to have a better resource deployment for the succes. - Project Cost in USD to understand the size of the project, so revenue mapping can be done. This tool is useful for project managers, resource planners, and leadership to get a snapshot of project details for risk assessment and future planning **Input:** - `project_name` (str): The name of the project to retrieve details for. **Returns:** A dictionary containing: - `project_name`: The queried project’s name - `start_date`: Project start date (YYYY-MM-DD) - `end_date`: Project end date (YYYY-MM-DD) - `classification`: Project classification level (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3) - `customer_impact`: Level of impact on customers (e.g., Low, Moderate, High, Innovation, Optimization, Enablement) - `complexity`: Project complexity (e.g., Medium, Very High) - `cloud_environment`: Cloud environment used (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, None) - `cloud_native_tool`: Cloud-native tool used (e.g., Fivetran, Matillion, None) - `dw_tool`: Data warehouse or processing tool used (e.g., Databricks, Synapse, Apache Spark) - `project_domain`: Domain or industry focus of the project (e.g., Healthcare, Travel & Hospitality) - `total_cost`: Total project cost in INR (float) If the project is not found, returns a message indicating absence of data. **Example Response:** { "project_name": "Grow Efficient Synergies", "start_date": "2025-02-11", "end_date": "2025-10-08", "classification": "Tier 1 (High budget, long duration, senior involvement)", "customer_impact": "Enablement", "complexity": "Medium", "cloud_environment": "Azure", "cloud_native_tool": "Fivetran", "dw_tool": "Snowflake", "project_domain": "Healthcare", "total_cost": 1018444.0 }

tools.name: Statistical_Analysis_MCP_student_t_test
tools.description: Accepts two groups of numeric data as comma-separated strings or DataFrame columns and performs Student's t-test. This test determines whether two independent groups have significantly different means, assuming populations from which the groups were sampled have equal variances (if this assumption is violated, or if equal population variance cannot be verified, use Welch's t-test instead). The test calculates a t-statistic quantifying the mean difference as a multiple of pooled standard deviation. Given an alternative hypothesis (group1 ≠ group2, group1 < group2, or group1 > group2), it outputs the p-value: the probability of observing this result (or more extreme) if no true difference exists. Results are statistically significant when p-value < alpha (typically 0.05). Cohen's d measures practical effect size, standardized by pooled standard deviation, with interpretation: |d| < 0.2 = negligible, 0.2-0.5 = small, 0.5-0.8 = medium, >0.8 = large (custom thresholds may be used). EXAMPLE USE CASES: treatment vs control groups, before/after measurements with different participants, comparing performance between demographic groups.

tools.name: SmartEnterpriseMCPAgents_mcphawk_get_project_milestones
tools.description: Returns all scheduled milestones and their dates for a given MCPHawk Inc project. This tool delivers a detailed timeline of milestones for a project, including: - Milestone names (e.g., Sprint-1, Sprint-2, QA Release, Production Release) - Corresponding milestone dates - Planned Cumulative Burn in USD for different project milestones - Actual Burn based on MCPHawk Inc employee billing - Cumulative Actual Burn rate basedon Actual Burn rate values (This is important to understand the financials of the project) This tool is helpful for project managers, scrum masters, and stakeholders to track progress, important delivery dates and understand if project is running within budget or not and understnad financial health of the project. **Input:** - `project_name` (str): The project whose milestones are requested. **Returns:** A dictionary containing: - `project_name` (str): The name of the project - `milestones` (list): A list of dictionaries, each with: - `milestone` (str): Name of the milestone (e.g., "Sprint-1", "QA Release") - `milestone_date` (date): Scheduled date for the milestone (in `YYYY-MM-DD` format) - `planned_cumulative_burn` (float): Planned cumulative burn amount by this milestone - `actual_burn` (float): Actual burn recorded for this milestone period - `cumulative_actual_burn` (float): Cumulative total of actual burn up to this milestone If no milestones are found, returns a message indicating absence of data. **Example Response:** { "project_name": "Grow Efficient Synergies", "milestones": [ { "milestone": "Sprint-1", "milestone_date": "2025-02-25", "planned_cumulative_burn": 113160.0, "actual_burn": 106528.85, "cumulative_actual_burn": 106529.0 }, { "milestone": "Sprint-2", "milestone_date": "2025-03-11", "planned_cumulative_burn": 226321.0, "actual_burn": 111444.79, "cumulative_actual_burn": 217974.0 }, { "milestone": "UAT Release", "milestone_date": "2025-05-20", "planned_cumulative_burn": 905283.52, "actual_burn": 107937.74, "cumulative_actual_burn": 881532.64 }, { "milestone": "Production Release", "milestone_date": "2025-05-27", "planned_cumulative_burn": 1018443.96, "actual_burn": 107682.72, "cumulative_actual_burn": 989215.36 } ] }
